note: **13 Lenton Avenue, schedule 169 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** Three women, no head marked - two domestic servants and Williamina G Seedbury, married, at unpaid domestic duties.
source: 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB, The National Archives RG101/6178A
